Remember: 8th Plan → HRD. Do not confuse this with heavy/capital-goods industries.
Q2 • POLITY / NEW CRIMINAL LAWS

BNSS 2023 — Forensic Evidence

7 years or more
The question links BNSS with mandatory forensic-expert visit and collection of forensic evidence for offences punishable with imprisonment of at least 7 years.
Number hook: BNSS → 7 years.
Q3 • CHEMISTRY

Endothermic Process

Thermal decomposition of limestone
The thermal decomposition of limestone (calcium carbonate) requires heat.
CaCO₃ + heat → CaO + CO₂
Endothermic = heat is absorbed. Dilution of concentrated H₂SO₄, quicklime + water, and acid-base neutralisation are treated as exothermic examples in this question.
Q4 • MEDIEVAL HISTORY

Lodi Dynasty — Immediate Successor

Bahlul Lodi → Sikandar Lodi
Bahlul Lodi: Founder of the Lodi dynasty.
Sikandar Lodi: Immediate successor of Bahlul.
Ibrahim Lodi: Successor of Sikandar; defeated by Babur in 1526.
Sequence: Bahlul → Sikandar → Ibrahim.

Q18 • PHYSICS / OPTICS

Lens Power +2.0 D

Hypermetropia → Convex lens
P = 1/f
Positive lens power indicates a converging/convex lens. For +2 D, focal length is 0.5 m.
Memory: + power → Convex; hypermetropia is corrected with a convex lens.

Q22 • ECONOMICS

Bandwagon Effect

Demand rises because others also buy/consume
Bandwagon: consumer demand is influenced upward by the consumption choices of others.
Snob: preference can be associated with exclusivity.
Veblen: conspicuous consumption linked to status/price.
Memory: Bandwagon = follow the crowd.

Memory: PMSBY → Suraksha → Accident → ₹20 / ₹2 lakh.
Q25 • PHYSICS / MOTION

Maximum Height of a Vertically Thrown Stone

10 m
Given u = 14 m/s, g = 9.8 m/s² and v = 0 at maximum height.
v² = u² − 2gh
H = u² / 2g = 196 / 19.6 = 10 m
Memory: At top → v = 0.
